caseName: Life v. Dep't of Health & Human Servs.
caseNameFull: PRIESTS FOR LIFE v. DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES

opinions.text: Motion of Association of American Physicians & Surgeons, et al. for leave to file a brief amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit granted. The case is consolidated.
